---
title: "Emisiones CO₂"
lang: es
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

files = sorted(Path("../lake/raw/co2").glob("fecha=*/*.parquet"))
df = pd.concat([pd.read_parquet(f) for f in files]) if files else pd.DataFrame()
if not df.empty:
    top = df.sort_values("co2", ascending=False).head(20)
    fig = px.bar(top, x="co2", y="country", title="CO₂ anual (Mt, OWID)",
                 labels={"co2":"Mt CO₂","country":"País"})
    fig.show()
    fig2 = px.scatter(df, x="co2_per_capita", y="co2", size="population", color="country",
                      title="CO₂ total vs per cápita", log_x=True, log_y=True)
    fig2.show()
    display(top[["country","iso3","anio","co2","co2_per_capita"]])
else:
    print("Sin datos CO₂: ejecuta python -m src.extract.owid_co2 --year 2023")
```
